::: {.home-right}

I am an applied economist specializing in development, health, and public policy. My research examines how economic resources and social policies shape family well-being, child development, and economic outcomes.

I am currently a **Visiting Professor at [Centro de Investigación y Docencia Económicas (CIDE)](https://www.cide.edu/)** and a **Consulting Economist at [Cardinal40](https://www.cardinal40.com/)**. 

Previously, I was a Postdoctoral Research Associate at Duke University. I received my Ph.D. in Economics from UCLA in 2024. 


[**More about me →**](about.qmd)

---

**Research Areas:** Development Economics · Health Economics · Public Policy · Social Protection · Policy Evaluation
